But it is not."},"philosophy":{"insight":"The self CANNOT be different from appropriation (aggregates) because we never find a self WITHOUT aggregates. QM: system = its properties. V.5: self = its aggregates. No \"bare\" entity underneath.","accessible":"Try to find \"yourself\" without any body, feelings, thoughts, or awareness. You can't. Ultimately: the self can't be separated from them — proving it's not an independent entity.","commonMisconception":"NOT proving the self IS the aggregates (that fails too — Ch.18).
